attestations.note: The life page is one entry for the two and heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 29 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Its whole body is the statement of attestation: «Άγνωστοι στον Συναξαριστή του Αγίου Νικόδημου. Μνημονεύονται στον Συναξαριστή Delehaye ως εξής: «Άθλησις των αγίων μαρτύρων Κυντιανού και Αττικού» (σελ. 640,6). Άλλες πληροφορίες για τη ζωή τους δεν αναφέρονται» — unknown to the synaxaristes of Saint Nikodemos, mentioned in Delehaye's at page 640 line 6, and no other information recorded. That is a statement about where the attestation lies and not a doubt about the men, so the folder stands; but no century, no place, no persecutor and no manner of death is printed, so there is no `dates` object and no `locations`. The line names both, so it is one folder each. It prints no couplet, no hymn and no relic. The corpus holds nobody of this name; its Quintilian of Ozovia is another man of another name.
